titlebar.reopenOnboarding: Double-click to reopen the onboarding guide
downloads.title: Progress
downloads.subtitle: View download & install progress, manage the game directory
downloads.engine.tsHint: No native core was found for this platform, so the app fell back automatically. Everything still works, but downloads are slower. Build it by double-clicking build-installer.bat in the project root, or by running npm run native:build.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Customize the launcher's appearance and behavior
settings.uapisKey.placeholder: Enter an API key (empty = guest quota)
settings.uapisKey.placeholderSet: Enter a new key to replace the saved one
settings.uapisKey.empty: Please enter an API key first
settings.uapisKey.statusSet: Status: saved. The key is stored on this machine with OS-level encryption and never shown in the UI unless you delete it.
settings.uapisKey.statusUnset: Status: not saved (using the guest quota, which is more limited).
settings.row.closeOnLaunch: Close launcher after launching the game
settings.debugKey.placeholder: Enter the debug key from the admin
settings.debugKey.placeholderSet: Enter a new key to replace the saved one
settings.debugKey.empty: Please enter a debug key first
settings.debugKey.ok: Uploaded. This key has {n} uses left
settings.debugKey.fail: Upload failed. Check that the key is correct or still has uses left
settings.debugKey.cleared: Debug key cleared; logs will no longer be uploaded automatically
settings.debugKey.statusSet: Status: saved. Diagnostic logs are uploaded to the server automatically; the key is never shown in the UI.
settings.debugKey.statusUnset: Status: not saved. Enter a key to send diagnostic logs back to the admin.
settings.debugKey.consentNotice: You agreed to collect diagnostic logs after submitting feedback. The launcher will upload diagnostic logs automatically.
feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.subtitle: Report an issue, suggestion, or bug. After verifying your email you can attach files such as screenshots and logs (up to {size} each).
feedback.field.title: Title
feedback.field.title.placeholder: Summarize your issue or suggestion in one line
feedback.field.desc.placeholder: Describe the issue in detail: steps to reproduce, expected result, actual result, etc.
feedback.file.hint: You can add multiple files, up to {size} each and {n} files in total (e.g. screenshots, crash logs)
feedback.file.empty: File "{name}" is empty and was skipped
feedback.file.tooMany: You can add at most {n} attachments
feedback.email.hint: Your email is used to receive the result; a verification code is required on submit.
feedback.code.sent: Code sent. You can resend in {n}s
feedback.code.sendFail: Failed to send the code, please try again later
feedback.submitFail: Submission failed, please try again later
feedback.privacy: We only use your email to reply to this feedback, never for anything else.
feedback.done.title: Submitted
feedback.done.desc: Thanks for your feedback! ID: {id}. We will look into it soon and send the result to your email.
feedback.collect.title: Allow collecting diagnostic logs?
feedback.collect.desc: To help the admin locate the issue faster, may this launcher automatically collect and upload diagnostic logs while you use it (system info and runtime logs, excluding sensitive data such as account passwords)? You can turn this off anytime in Settings.
feedback.gate.intro: Enter your email and verify it with a code to view all the feedback you have submitted.
feedback.gate.hint: Your verification is stored only on this device; after signing out or expiry you will need to verify your email again.
feedback.ttl.label: Stay signed in
feedback.ttl.desc: After verification the email code is exchanged for a credential, so viewing the conversation and sending messages no longer need another code. "This session" keeps the credential in memory only: leaving the feedback page or restarting the launcher signs you out.
feedback.verify.fail: Verification failed, please try again later
feedback.list.empty: No feedback has been submitted with this email yet.
feedback.detail.closed: This feedback is closed; you can no longer send messages.
feedback.detail.withdrawn: This feedback has been withdrawn; you can no longer send messages.
feedback.detail.msgEmpty: Enter a message or add an attachment.
feedback.detail.sendFail: Failed to send, please try again later.
feedback.detail.downloadFail: Download failed, please try again later.
feedback.detail.filesHint: Multiple attachments allowed, each up to {size}, {n} per message
feedback.withdraw.confirm: Withdraw feedback "{title}"? This cannot be undone, and only unreplied feedback can be withdrawn.
feedback.withdraw.fail: Withdrawal failed, please try again later
settings.row.metadataOnly: Mod info is read from metadata only
settings.source.auto: Prefer official, switch to mirror when slow
settings.communitySource.auto: Use mirror only when the official source is slow
settings.modTitle.translatedFirst: Title shows translated name, details show filename
settings.modTitle.filenameFirst: Title shows filename, details show translated name
settings.communityDisabled: Chinese-name translation is temporarily withdrawn; the options below are unavailable.
settings.row.autoCheckLauncher: Check for launcher updates on startup
settings.exp.github.previewHint: Tip: hover (or focus with the keyboard) any card to preview the whole UI in that scheme; move away to go back. Click to apply.
settings.exp.autoTheme.desc: Falls back automatically when no wallpaper is set or it fails to load
settings.exp.hardwareAcceleration.restar: Saved — takes effect after a restart
settings.exp.multiplayer.inLobby: You are currently in a lobby, so this cannot be changed. Leave the lobby from the Multiplayer page or the floating window first, then come back to toggle this switch.
settings.dev.intro: For homepage script developers: use an email authorized on the backend; after entering the email and verifying the code, you get a 1-day developer mode authorization.
settings.dev.security.full.desc: Full simulation: any suspicious homepage script behavior is blocked and locked as usual, matching the production environment.
settings.dev.security.warn.desc: Warn only: suspicious behavior is reported truthfully but the script is not blocked, making it easier to diagnose.
settings.dev.security.off.desc: Disabled: no security checks; homepage scripts run freely (debugging only—do not leave on long-term).
settings.dev.security.disabledNotice: (Developer mode is off, so these levels have no effect yet; the homepage still runs in "Full simulation".)
settings.dev.openDevToolsError: Cannot open DevTools: enable developer mode first.
settings.dev.err.emailRequired: Please enter the authorized email first
settings.dev.err.inputRequired: Please enter the email and verification code
settings.dev.notice.verified: Verified; developer mode enabled for 1 day
settings.dev.confirm.revoke: Revoke developer mode authorization? You'll need to verify your email again to re-enable it.
settings.game.desktopFullscreenNotice: Desktop mode is active: the MC window size is forced to "Fullscreen".
settings.game.custom.locked: Preview disabled: the window size exceeds the screen
settings.game.custom.exceed: The size {w}×{h} exceeds the screen {sw}×{sh}; the game window may be clipped. You will be warned again at launch.
settings.java.none: No Java detected; please specify a path manually
settings.java.autoDetectHint: Auto-detect is on: the launcher picks the right Java for each game version, so selecting from the list is disabled (you can still add one via "Specify manually").
settings.java.manual.title: Turn off auto-detect?
settings.java.manual.desc: The manually specified Java will be used instead, and the launcher will no longer switch Java per game version. This may cause launch failures if the Java version does not match.
settings.win10.title: Enable Win10 desktop mode?
settings.win10.desc: This feature is buggy; recommended for trying out and testing only.
settings.updLog.title: New version available: v{v}
